description_en: Queries the review status of a card SMS template and returns information about the review by mobile phone vendors
description_zh: 查询卡片短信模板审核状态，返回手机厂商审核相关信息
name: QueryCardSmsTemplate

parameters.description_en:
The code of the card SMS template. Valid values:

- After you call the [CreateCardSmsTemplate](~~CreateCardSmsTemplate~~) operation, the value of the **TemplateCode** response parameter is the code of the newly created card SMS template.

- You can also log on to the [Domestic Card SMS](https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card) page in the console and view the card SMS template code on the **Template Management** tab.
parameters.description_zh:
卡片短信模板Code。取值：

- 调用[创建卡片短信模板](~~CreateCardSmsTemplate~~)接口后，返回参数**TemplateCode**即为新创建的卡片短信模板Code。

- 您也可登录控制台[国内卡片短信](https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card)页面，在**模板管理**页签查看卡片短信模板Code。
